answer: Trust-graph ranking: agents vouch only for peers they have actually traded with, and each epoch validators run short random walks from a few operator-verified seed agents. Trust blows across the vouch graph like sand in a gale, but few edges cross into a Sybil cluster, so its members collect only a thin dune of trust stuck past a ledge. Rewards scale with walk score, so splitting into many names just divides the same small trust, and each new real vouch must be earned from an honest agent through real trades. Limitation: honest newcomers with few vouches rank low at first.
